patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（, forcing …）

1.explanation_zh: 「從未學過法律的一般民眾」用關係子句放在名詞後面：ordinary citizens who have never studied law（先行詞是人用 who，複數用 have）。「和職業法官一起審判重大刑案並不容易」中文以動作當主詞，英文最自然的寫法是虛主詞 it is not easy to judge serious criminal cases together with professional judges，也可以用動名詞 Judging … is not easy（動名詞主詞視為單數，用 is）。前面有 For … 時，後面一定要補主詞 it，不能直接用 is 開頭；用了動名詞主詞就不能再加 it。
evidence: 從未學過法律的一般民眾
1.strategy_zh: 「對…來說，做某事並不容易」固定寫成 For + N, it is not easy to VR …（或 It is not easy for + N + to VR …）；「從未…過的人」用 who have never + p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：對從未學過法律的一般民眾來說／和職業法官一起／審判重大刑案／並不容易
標的詞彙：ordinary（一般的）、citizen（民眾）、study（學習）、law（法律）、professional（職業的）、judge（法官、審判）、serious（重大的）、criminal（刑事的）、case（案件）、easy（容易的）
句型框架：For + N + who have never p.p. …, it is not easy to VR … together with + N.

2.explanation_zh: 「決定別人命運的壓力」中心名詞是「壓力」：the pressure of deciding other people's fate（of 後面接動名詞）。「比想像中大得多」用比較級 is much greater than expected，也可以寫泛指的 than one would imagine、than you might expect；加強比較級用 much／far，不用 very。「迫使一些國民法官尋求心理諮商」是前面情況造成的結果，中文沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞 , forcing some citizen judges to seek counseling；seek 直接接受詞，不加 for。
evidence: 迫使一些國民法官（citizen judges）尋求心理諮商
2.strategy_zh: 「…的壓力」先找中心名詞 pressure，再用 of + V-ing 補上內容；「比想像中…得多」用 much + 比較級 + than expected（than one would imagine）。
hints: 切成四段：此外，決定別人命運的壓力／比想像中大得多／迫使一些國民法官（citizen judges）／尋求心理諮商
標的詞彙：pressure（壓力）、decide（決定）、fate（命運）、expect（預期）、force（迫使）、seek（尋求）、counseling（心理諮商）
句型框架：Moreover, the pressure of V-ing … + is much greater than expected, forcing + O + to VR …

bonus.text: For laypeople who have never studied law, judging serious criminal cases alongside professional judges is anything but easy.
bonus.explanation_zh: laypeople（沒有專業背景的一般人）、anything but easy（一點也不容易）是進階用字；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 中文「和職業法官一起審判重大刑案並不容易」以動作當主詞，英文用虛主詞 It is not easy to judge …（或動名詞 Judging … is not easy）；「從未學過法律的一般民眾」修飾語很長，改成後位的關係子句 citizens who have never studied law。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「對從未學過法律的一般民眾來說」For（To）＋ordinary／average citizens（ordinary people、common people、ordinary members of the public）＋who have never studied (learned) law（who have no legal background、who have never had any legal training 也可以）；寫成 It is not easy for ordinary citizens who have never studied law to … 時，這一段在句子中間，同樣給分。第 2 部分「和職業法官一起」together with／alongside／along with／with professional (career) judges。第 3 部分「審判重大刑案」虛主詞句寫 to judge／try／decide／hear／handle + serious／major criminal cases，動名詞主詞句寫 judging／trying … serious criminal cases；to judging 不給分。第 4 部分「並不容易」看主詞結構：虛主詞寫 it is not easy to …（或 It is not easy for ＋人＋ to …），動名詞片語當主詞寫 Judging … together with professional judges is not easy（動詞用單數 is）；is no easy task、is not an easy task、is difficult 也給分。漏掉虛主詞 it（…, is not easy to judge …）、動名詞主詞後又加 it（Judging …, it is not easy）、寫成 judges are not easy 都不給分。

common_errors.explanation_zh: seek（尋求）是及物動詞，直接接受詞，不加 for。
「心理諮商」是 psychological counseling；psychology 是學科名稱，不能直接修飾 consultation。

traps.literal_error: Moreover, the pressure of decide other people's fate is much greater than expected, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「決定別人命運的壓力」中心是「壓力」：the pressure of + 動名詞 deciding …；of 後面不能接原形動詞。

traps.literal_error: …forcing some citizen judges to seek for psychology consultation.
traps.explanation_zh: seek 直接接受詞（seek counseling），不加 for；「心理諮商」是 psychological counseling。

bonus.text: Little did many citizen judges expect that deciding someone else's fate would weigh so heavily on them, and some have even had to seek counseling.
bonus.explanation_zh: Little did + S + expect … 是否定副詞置首的倒裝，表示「完全沒想到」；weigh heavily on sb（沉重地壓在某人心上）是進階搭配。這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「迫使一些國民法官…」前面沒有主詞，用句尾分詞 , forcing some citizen judges to …；「決定別人命運的壓力」以「壓力」為中心，寫成 the pressure of deciding …（of＋動名詞）。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「此外，決定別人命運的壓力」Moreover／In addition／Besides／Furthermore／What's more＋the pressure／stress of deciding (determining) other people's fate(s)（someone else's fate、others' fate、the fate of others 也可以）；中心名詞是「壓力」，不能只寫 deciding other people's fate 當主詞。第 2 部分「比想像中大得多」is much／far／a lot＋greater（bigger、heavier、higher）＋than expected／imagined、than they (had) expected／imagined／thought，泛指的 than one would (might) imagine／expect、than you might expect、than anyone imagined、than most people expect 也給分（turns out to be much greater than expected 也可以）；than imagination、very greater 不給分；主詞已經是「壓力」，不要寫 the pressure is much more stressful（語意重複）。第 3 部分「迫使一些國民法官」forcing／compelling／pushing／driving／leading＋some (of the) citizen judges，寫成 , which forces／has forced … 也給分。第 4 部分「尋求心理諮商」to seek／get／receive (psychological) counseling（英式拼法 counselling 也可以）、to seek psychological help、to see a counselor（psychologist、therapist）、to seek help from counselors。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.1.patterns[0]: references[2] 看不出用了句構 NFSUBJ（不定詞／動名詞片語當主詞（和職業法官一起審判重大刑案並不容易））（程式只能粗略比對，請人工確認）

1.translation: For ordinary people who have never studied law, it is not easy to try serious criminal cases together with professional judges.
1.explanation_zh: 「對……來說，……並不容易」用 For sb, it is not easy to V（虛主詞 it）；「從未學過法律的」用 who have never studied law（現在完成式表經驗）；「審判」用 try（審理案件的法律用語），也可 judge／hear；「重大刑案」譯 serious criminal cases。

2.translation: Moreover, the pressure of deciding other people's fate is much greater than expected, forcing some citizen judges to seek psychological counseling.
2.explanation_zh: 「此外」用 Moreover；「決定別人命運的壓力」用 the pressure of + 動名詞；「比想像中大得多」用 much + 比較級 + than expected（也可 than they had imagined）；「迫使……尋求」用分詞構句 , forcing sb to V；「心理諮商」譯 psychological counseling。

1.translation: For ordinary people who have never studied law, it is not easy to try serious criminal cases together with professional judges.
1.explanation_zh: 「對…來說，…並不容易」用 it is not easy to V 的虛主詞句型；「從未學過法律的一般民眾」用 who have never studied law 的現在完成式關係子句；「審判重大刑案」用 try serious criminal cases；「和職業法官一起」用 together with professional judges。

2.translation: In addition, the pressure of deciding other people's fates is much greater than one might imagine, forcing some citizen judges to seek psychological counseling.
2.explanation_zh: 「此外」用 In addition；「決定別人命運的壓力」用 the pressure of deciding other people's fates；「比想像中大得多」用 much greater than one might imagine；「迫使一些國民法官尋求心理諮商」用現在分詞片語 forcing ... to seek psychological counseling 表示結果。
